note: Published briefing `sourceTier` values that contradict the tier the same-date assessment cites for the same URL. Enforced by `research/scripts/test-source-tier-consistency.mjs` (CS-2 / DC-04). THIS LIST IS EMPTY AND SHOULD STAY EMPTY. It exists because the mismatches it would hold live in dated, published briefings, and AUTONOMY §1c forbids retro-editing those: a reader who saw tier 4 on a given date was misled, and silently rewriting the file to say 2 conceals that rather than correcting it. So a mismatch that has already reached readers is recorded here WITH ITS DATE alongside a published correction, and the list may only shrink. A mismatch found BEFORE publication must be fixed in the briefing, not added here. Do not add an entry to silence a gate failure.
